# The Lighthouse School

> The Lighthouse School is an international school in Pedatadivada, Denkada Mandal, Vizianagaram, Andhra Pradesh, India.

The school offers a child-centred learning environment with modern A/C classrooms, touch panel learning spaces, science and mathematics labs, sports infrastructure, residential facilities, holistic curriculum, IIT-JEE and NEET coaching, and admissions for the 2026-27 academic year.
